attributes.context: The clause appears under the heading “E. Virtual Orchestra” in the Spokane Civic Theatre/Professional Musicians AFM 105 CBA section also covering recorded music, promotional recordings, and ADA-related recordings.

extraction_text: The Employer shall not be permitted to use a Virtual Orchestra or any similar mechanical device which replaces Musicians, except with the explicit written approval of the Local.
